name: 53202 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53202 (Milwaukee) has 469 nonprofit organizations. 173 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 155 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53202 (Milwaukee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
